limitations: This is reused development validation; head64/128 were trained and selected using related development data.
The two readouts share selectedheads/train data/scaler and are correlated; mixtures are not independent estimators.
The tail is a subset of long-full, and10 long validation sources overlap long-single; profile counts are not summed as independent sources.
This protocol is proposed after a prior independent confirmation indicated further work; that test is not read or used to rank alpha/tau.
Previously seen C4/natural tests cannot be reused as a new independent confirmation or to pick alpha/tau.
No prior frozen source, selection, threshold, model, current-model pointer or test artifact may be changed.

The legacy mean-helper control intentionally preserves its published F64 sorted-count semantics. V2 does not rewrite any original threshold or retroactively recalibrate an old model. The new maximin branch alone is repaired and fully direct-count checked.
